ScenPartDef.label: Hearth & Harbor rules
ScenPartDef.description: Sets modules, hosting difficulty, content intensity and any per-colony setting of Hearth & Harbor and Silverline for new colonies of this scenario. Only what is set here overrides the template; the player can still change everything on the storyteller page.

ScenPartDef.label: Hearth & Harbor setting
ScenPartDef.description: Sets one Hearth & Harbor or Silverline setting to a value for new colonies of this scenario.

ScenPartDef.label: start with Hearth & Harbor research
ScenPartDef.description: A Hearth & Harbor or Silverline research project is already finished when the colony starts.
